item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 08/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine with cool mornings over southern China in the next couple of days. The monsoon is expected to moderate and will be replaced gradually by a warm maritime airstream in the latter part of this week. The weather will be humid, foggy and cloudier over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week.
